name: Multi-Dimensional Interpolation Extension
definition: Method 1: Separable extension. Uses each coordinate as a free variable, separating 1D kernels and multiplying results. This is the correct way to extend filters to higher dimensions for regular meshes.
summary: Multi-Dimensional Interpolation Extension constructs 3D filters from 1D kernels, distinguishing itself by using separable methods to avoid the sample frequency ripple artifacts caused by radial extension on regular grids.
